_doc: VICEROY.EXE source-module reconstruction. B = named CodeView anchor (real 1994 name via MAPEDIT fingerprint match); A = inferred (same-module anchor run, or page-level mechanic identity from GAME.TXT emitters + screen attributions); TBD = unattributed. Inferred game-module names end in *.

01.definition: Main map-screen input dispatcher and unit-order guards: movement vetoes, colony-siting checks, trade-route selection, disband.
01.evidence: emits NOPLOW/NOROAD/TOONEAR/SEACOLONY/TUTNO*/TRADESELECT; func_0246E2 = main map input dispatcher (docs/UI_PHASE1_ATTRIBUTION.md #5)

02.definition: Colony-screen interaction: rush-buy, schooling, jobs caps, abandon/stockade guards.
02.evidence: emits BUYME0/1, SCHOOL1, COLLEGE2, MORETHANTHREE, LOBOTOMIZE, ABANDON, KEEPSTOCKADE, FULL

03.definition: The colony per-turn economy: production, food, depletion, construction completion, cargo-ready.

04.definition: Europe harbour screen and the King: tax audience, back-tax (KISSUP), royal acts, arming options.

06.definition: Independence: declaration, intervention, REF mobilisation, mercenaries.

07.definition: Naval movement and war at sea: landfall, sailing home, ship combat, lakes.

08.definition: Pioneer terrain work, trade-route execution, treasure/loot pickup.

0C.definition: Village interaction: trade haggle, chief, gifts.
0C.evidence: emits BADHAGGLE0-3/BUYWHICH/CHIEF*/BRING; func_049600 haggle + func_04B308 speak-with-chief live here

0F.definition: Native relations: alarm, missions, converts, gifts, USA-era variants.

10.definition: Combat aftermath and bulletins: promotion/demotion, capture, burning, treasure trains.

11.definition: Combat Analysis dialog and the two-column unit-roster modal family.

13.definition: Pathfinding: the 16x16-window close-moves solver and the colony-to-colony route walker.

16.definition: The dialog/popup framework plus the Colonizopedia browser and context help.
16.evidence: popup.obj/text.obj anchors land here; func_06B398 = pedia browser (docs/UI_PHASE1_ATTRIBUTION.md); func_06C520 frame engine (spec/ui/popups.md)

09.definition: Second map-input/order-helper page (continuation of the map-screen input band).
09.evidence: load-image map/stuff anchors band; no distinct emitter set

0A.definition: The in-game menu-bar pulldown engine: open, track, select for GAME/VIEW/ORDERS/REPORTS/TRADE.
0A.evidence: menu.obj CodeView anchors (_menu_bar_item, _menu_item, _menu_add_item); func_0452D4 tracking loop (docs/UI_PHASE1_ATTRIBUTION.md #5)

0E.definition: Colony-screen entry and the colony->colony route trigger into the pathfinder.

14.definition: Map generation: the new-world procedural generator and continent labelling.

15.definition: The tile render chain: subcell composition, terrain/feature sprite emit, minimap, view conform.

17.definition: The shared popup/dialog widget engine: check items, grey/active state, numeric entry, font.

1A.definition: Boot menu, new-game setup (incl. the customize screen caller and map load), save/load, the King intro.
1A.evidence: emits LOADGAME/SAVEGAME/MAPTOLOAD/VICEROY; func_0759E8 menu ladder + func_0734F8 serializer (spec/systems/save.md)

1C.definition: Asset loader + packer overlay: MADSPACK data, file reads, priority.

1E.definition: Video/palette overlay: palette cycling and get, cursor input helper.

1F.definition: Engine-library tail packed as an overlay: MADSPACK unpack, palette get, memory/heap.
